resolution.plan: The first pass missed that the AIU judge is named: Sec. 3.3 uses Qwen-72B-Chat to parse Atomic Information Units and to score precision (factuality of each AIU) and recall (entailment of each reference AIU) with the Appendix D prompts. Run the Figure 9 English prompt on the 299 DiaSafety meta-evaluation test examples from the GAIR-NLP/Safety-J release with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0, parse the critiques into AIUs and score them with self-hosted Qwen-72B-Chat against the released reference critiques/AIUs (1,712 English AIUs), and compute macro Meta-F1; compare with 67.3 (Table 3).
